# Known-answer and profile vectors of package secobj.
#
# Records are separated by blank lines; each line is "field: value". Byte
# fields are hex; namespace fields are separated by spaces; private
# properties are "type=value", where the value of an even type is decimal and
# the value of an odd type is hex.
#
# Sources:
# - rfc9605-*: RFC 9605 appendix C.3, cipher_suite 0x0004, copied from the RFC.
# - secobj01-*: draft-ietf-moq-secure-objects-01 appendix B.1 to B.4, copied
#   from the draft. B.3 and B.4 encode the Immutable Properties in the draft's
#   own form (16-bit type and a length), which is not the draft-22 form the
#   Kolo profile uses, so only their AEAD inputs and outputs are checked.
# - kolo-*: Kolo profile vectors (ADR 0010). Every output field was computed
#   by an independent program that does not use this package: HKDF written
#   from RFC 5869 on crypto/hmac and cross-checked against crypto/hkdf, vi64
#   and the full track name written from draft-ietf-moq-transport-22 section
#   8.1, AES-128-GCM from crypto/aes and crypto/cipher. The same program
#   reproduces every RFC 9605 and Secure Objects vector above.
